d:
PM Modi Vaishali Visit :pradhanmantri narendr modi ke 21 navanbar ko sanbhavit bihar daure ko lekar taiyariyan tej ho gaee hain. piem modi ke vaishali daure ke dauran siks len pul ka udghatan kie jane ki sanbhavna hai. vahin, rajapakar-jandaha ke indastriyal park men bhi karyakram prastavit hai.
Is bich bihar sarkar ke mantri dilip jayasval ne pradhanmantri ke prastavit daure ko lekar bara bayan diya hai. unhonne kaha ki vaishali men udyog ke kshetr men bara kam hoga. is daure se kshetr men audyogik vikas aur kanektiviti ko lekar naee ummiden juri hain.
